features_verified: GET /api/digest/preview returns digest data with all sections (scheduled_employees, overdue_invoices, jobs_today, pending_approvals, yesterday_revenue, unread_messages)
POST /api/digest/send manually sends the digest and returns results
GET /api/digest/settings returns default settings (enabled=false, schedule_time=07:00, recipients=[])
PUT /api/digest/settings updates settings (enable toggle, schedule time, add recipients)
GET /api/digest/history returns list of sent digests
Dashboard 'Send Digest' button appears in Quick Actions section
Dashboard 'Send Digest' button calls POST /api/digest/send and shows toast
Settings > Daily Digest page loads with Schedule card (enable toggle, time picker)
Settings > Daily Digest page has Recipients section (add/remove emails)
Settings > Daily Digest page shows 'What's Included' section with 6 digest items
Settings > Daily Digest page has 'Recent Sends' collapsible section
'Daily Digest' link appears in Settings sub-nav ribbon
Navigation to /settings/digest works from Settings tab
context_for_next_testing_agent: Daily Digest feature fully tested and working. Backend has /api/digest/* endpoints (preview, send, settings, history). APScheduler runs every minute checking if any tenant's schedule_time matches current UTC time. Frontend has Settings page at /settings/digest with enable toggle, time picker, and recipient management. Dashboard has 'Send Digest' quick action that calls POST /api/digest/send. SendGrid is configured for real email delivery (not mocked).
